findings.summary: Planner and critic are conditional roles but can still be flagged as retire candidates
findings.evidence: athena.toml [job_plan] has mode = "hard": planner and critic run only for jobs whose reading is marked hard, and not at all when enabled = false. Eight consecutive non-hard jobs, or planning switched off, would make `athena status` advise retiring both, the same kind of false positive this retry fixed for the auditor. In the real-records snapshot planner runs are frequent (e.g. 20261111-064834-q749), so this is not triggered today. A more correct approach is to measure planner/critic against hard-marked jobs only, or report them as not measured when planning is off. The accepted reading named only steward/audience/auditor, so this is a follow-up.

findings.summary: The list of measured built-in roles is written out by hand
findings.evidence: compute lists Reader, Planner, Critic, Producer and Verifier explicitly. A new Role variant would be neither measured nor reported as not measured. Deriving the list from an exhaustive match on Role (or a Role::ALL constant) would make adding a role a compile error until it is classified.

summary: The candidate rebuilds the OLY-9-11 role-need measure on Records::all_invocations and fixes the earlier rejection's findings. The steward, audience and auditor are reported as "not measured" and never as retire candidates. The split between job and out-of-job run lists is documented in store.rs and docs/system-facts.md. A store test checks that every loaded invocation appears in all_invocations. Jobs that never ran a model are left out of the window. I ran the targeted tests: `cargo test -p athena-core store`, `cargo test -p athena-core role_need` and `cargo test -p athena-cli --test status_role_need` all pass. fmt, clippy and the full test suite passed in CI for this commit. On the real-records snapshot, planner runs appear in recent jobs (e.g. 20261111-064834-q749), so planner and critic would most likely not be flagged today. There are three minor findings. (1) Planner and critic run only for hard jobs, so they can be advised for retirement after eight non-hard jobs. (2) The list of measured roles is written out by hand. (3) An out-of-scope edit to briefs.rs raises the system-facts size budget from 5,000 to 6,000 bytes. None of these blocks the change.
